The Son of man is about to make 4 his second advent into the world, to reign a thousand years: in which time satan is to be bound. See Rev. 20:1,2. “And I saw an angel come down from heaven, having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand. And he laid hold on the dragon that old serpent, which is the devil and satan, and bound him a thousand years.” —
